context:
Goal: keep the number of Neon databases down.
Problem (rule): your 12:04 ruling, 'sessions never touch Neon', names no scope. On your Mac, `npm run worktree:new` and the worktree hook give each worktree its own Neon branch when NEON_API_KEY is set.
Based on (owner): your 12:04 CST words in runner 9's chat.
Based on (read): harness/worktree-hook.mjs and `npm run worktree:new` in q_max create a Neon branch per worktree.
Departs from: q_max main gives each worktree a Neon branch — cloud sessions skip Neon (being built now), and option b also stops Mac sessions.
Meanwhile: the lane builds the cloud-only skip and refusal, which hold under both answers.

options.gain: Mac worktrees keep a real Neon branch with real data.
options.label: Cloud sessions only
options.lose: Each Mac worktree still adds a Neon database.

options.gain: No session adds a Neon database.
options.label: Every session, Mac too (recommended: matches your words)
